skills.hint: Draft text, output language and target journal

skills.hint: Data or draft figure, purpose and Python/R preference

skills.hint: Paper or reading notes, presentation duration and audience

workflows.name: Paper to presentation
workflows.instruction: Create source-linked reading notes, then a lab-meeting deck and speaker notes. Preserve evidence figures and limitations; adapt to the requested duration and language.

workflows.name: Pre-submission check
workflows.instruction: Audit statistical reporting, review arguments and evidence, then polish supported statements. Without raw data, do not claim recomputation. Do not invent remedies or change results. List unresolved issues without guaranteeing submission readiness.

workflows.name: Reviewer response and revision
workflows.instruction: Map reviewer comments to issues, revise the manuscript using available evidence, draft point-by-point responses, then verify each change. Distinguish completed work from proposed experiments; never invent results.
